working: The potential depends only on the start and end points, so the path through the tube does not matter. Outside the sphere, V = Q/(4πε0 r), where Q = (4/3)πR³ρ. The work magnitude for a unit charge is |V_A − V_B| = (Q/4πε0)(1/(2R) − 1/(3R)) = (ρR³/(3ε0))·(1/(6R)) = ρR²/(18ε0). This is the work by the field (equivalently the external agent's work). The literal net work on a slowly moved charge would be zero, which is not an option. So n = 18.
